Connect bidirectional real UART plus public QMP; apply exact paired boot graph while stopped

stop; public project-json Apply exact peer graph; record real factory status/config identity and electrical snapshot
Queue lifecycle G byte while stopped; cont; collect DONE or actual negative boundary

Discover actual peer/controller transition retained ranges via status-json; page optional scoped transitions windows with absolute offsets and count<=1024. Preserve actual epochs, complete-source boundaries, total/first_sequence/lost/capacity; never guess a lost range or infer controller from geometry

Automatically require the unique fresh-VM FIFO LOAD source_word_id1, derive its origin epoch and actual controller/peer COMPLETE epoch lists, and run independent qualify_transition_inputs on this run's exact RX/DIN/transition bytes; no manual launcher attribution option
Preserve native record-directory controller RX files, all UART, QMP requests/replies/events, snapshots, command, hashes and actual failures

profiles.connected: Require exact independent source1 guest bytehash, complete8 descriptors, DMA callbacks and ISR cadence, then automatically qualify actual source1 RX/source0 DIN using genuine native activation/source IDs and COMPLETE phases. Missing/lost/unusable phase seam or independent mismatch is failure, never an unattributed success.
profiles.power-unknown: Only disconnect peer VDD into floating net; keep MCU3.3V. Require actual power_known false, powered false and zero DIN captures.
profiles.power-off: Only tie peer VDD to real shared GND; keep MCU3.3V. Require actual known/unpowered rails and zero DIN captures.
profiles.exhaustion: Set actual immutable peer repeat false; require actual exhausted status. No fabricated exhausted clock or completion expectation.
profiles.capture-overflow: Set actual bounded peer captureCapacity32; require actual overflow status and32 retained real captures. No unbounded retention claim.

attribution.mode: Mandatory automatic native phase attribution for connected runs; launcher --attribution/manual phase path removed. The standalone reference CLI may still accept an explicit independently authored finite manifest.
attribution.binding: Inputs are this run's exact RX file, complete DIN page export and actual scoped transition pages, bound to the actual peer ID/config identity. No old or synthetic capture can qualify a new run.
attribution.reference: peer_reference.py qualify_transition_inputs independently checks source1 RX and source0 DIN every sample/slot, sparseTDM physical spacing, raw16bit chronological words and actual rational bit/frame cadence within1ns; each range>=768frames.
attribution.prerequisite: Require exactly one fresh-VM controller FIFO LOAD with source_word_id1; derive controller_origin_epoch from it and actual controller/peer COMPLETE epoch lists. Never scan matching prefixes, trim mismatches, use TXattempts/ISR callbacks/playback as physical input, or manufacture capture events.
attribution.fullPass: All68 ordinary actual launch rows automatically qualify finite bidirectional samples against the native phase seam. A successful selected subset is not full68 qualification. Hardware and exact PCM converters remain explicitly unqualified.

transitionExport.contract: contract-v1.json captureInterface and actual esp32s3_i2s_peer.h/esp32s3_i2s.h getter ABI
transitionExport.response: Existing DIN capture-json plus transitions={version:1,peer:actual peer window,controller:actual selected C controller window}. Status discovery has peers[].transitions summary and controllers[] summaries plus capture_enabled; disabled native capture is explicit, no fabricated range.
transitionExport.phase: Peer COMPLETE is actual outgoing publication plus serial BCLK/physical raw WS boundary, not a DIN-success proxy; controller LOAD is never COMPLETE. Payload-free IDs/cursors/epochs/first-last emitted and boundary times attribute actual samples, which remain the sole data oracle.
transitionExport.retention: count is retained total, not page length; records length<=1024; first_sequence=total-count=lost. Export every retained phase record and every actual DIN event, including startup idle. Any metadata loss is explicit and prevents claiming unavailable attribution.
transitionExport.proof: Changed source hashes require a fresh whole native binary and positive ordinary peer run after the all-land freeze. Existing GDB diagnostic/helper/static evidence does not qualify the new native phase contract.

exitCodes.0: All68 automatic native-phase physical qualification, or requested genuine negative boundary profile passes
exitCodes.1: Actual failure, unavailable/unusable native phase seam or independent reference mismatch
exitCodes.2: Selected connected subset qualifies automatically but is not full68 physical qualification

failureEvidence: After an actual failure, stop and always preserve the actual electrical failure snapshot plus already collected UART/QMP/process evidence. Query optional peer status and export failure DIN/transition pages only after the peer graph was successfully Applied. A failure before peer Apply must not be rewritten as a nonexistent peer/factory/capture failure; preserve the real boot/source boundary without fabricated fallback state.
tests: test_run_peer.py and test_peer_reference.py are SYNTHETIC parser/math only, never native runtime evidence.

standalonePdm.scope: Standalone MCU raw packing helper, generated independent240 vectors and seeded225288-edge mathematics, normal and ASan/UBSan. No integrated native VM, exact PCM converter or hardware qualification.
standalonePdm.preservation: Fresh output directory; previous evidence untouched; source hashes must remain unchanged across all checks.

changelog: Adds complete68 ordinary interactive native launcher, real closed publicQMP paginated exporter, actual RX file retention, explicit electrical negative boundaries and fail-closed finite attribution binding.

Extends existing capture/status QOM properties with actual scoped controller/peer phase windows and explicit metadata retention/loss; preserves all DIN fields/startup events and forbids payload echo or synthetic phase fallback.
Cuts launcher over to mandatory automatic genuine native-phase qualification; removes manual launcher attribution path and preserves automatic transition/reference evidence.

Preserves actual electrical failure snapshots even before peer Apply; optional peer evidence is queried only after successful peer Apply, retaining genuine boot failures instead of manufacturing absent-peer failures.
